title: AI-Powered Contract Review Platform for Legal Teams
excerpt: How we built an intelligent contract analysis platform that extracts key clauses, flags risks, and generates summary reports - reducing manual review time by 80% for Jurata's clients.
challenge: Jurata, a Frankfurt-based legal tech startup, saw that corporate legal teams were spending thousands of hours manually reviewing contracts. Junior lawyers would spend days reading through standard agreements to find non-standard clauses, liability caps, and termination conditions. The process was slow, expensive, and error-prone - critical clauses were sometimes missed entirely.
solution: We built an AI-powered contract review platform using Next.js for the frontend and a Python-based NLP pipeline on the backend. Users upload contracts in PDF or DOCX format, and the system automatically extracts and categorizes key clauses - including liability limitations, indemnification terms, payment schedules, and termination rights. A risk scoring engine flags unusual or potentially problematic language against a configurable baseline. The platform generates structured summary reports that legal teams can review in minutes instead of hours. We also built a clause library where teams can save and compare language across their contract portfolio.
results: Contract review time reduced by 80% - from 4 hours average to under 45 minutes
AI clause extraction achieves 94% accuracy across common contract types
Risk flagging catches non-standard terms that manual review missed in 23% of test cases
Clause library enables teams to compare language across 1,000+ contracts instantly
Platform processes contracts in 12 languages with consistent extraction quality

testimonial.quote: Our lawyers used to dread contract review. Sebastian and his team delivered something that transformed the work - now they upload a document and get a structured summary in minutes. The risk flagging has already caught issues that would have cost our clients real money.
testimonial.author: Dr. A. Weber
